name: anyrun-sandbox
label: ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox
description:
ANY.RUN empowers SOC teams to cut MTTD/MTTR with fast verdicts using the Interactive Sandbox. With the ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox connector for FortiSOAR, your team achieves:
- Faster triage: Submit files/URLs for instant analysis across Windows, Linux, Android. Get answers in seconds to catch threats that beat standard defenses and increase the detection rate by up to 36%.
- Streamlined workflows: Retrieve reports (JSON, HTML, IOCs) directly in FortiSOAR without tool-switching. Act without delays to stop attacks before they have a chance to hurt your infrastructure.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is set as True.

operations.title: Delete analysis
operations.description: Deletes a analysis from ANY.RUN Sandbox based on the ID you have specified.

operations.title: Detonate File
operations.description: Detonates a file in ANY.RUN Sandbox based on the indicator or attachment IRI you have specified.

parameters.title: Attachment IRI
parameters.name: attachment_iri
parameters.tooltip: IRI of the indicator or attachment you want to detonate in ANY.RUN Sandbox.

operations.title: Get History
operations.description: Retrieves analysis history from ANY.RUN Sandbox based on input parameters you have specified.

parameters.title: Team
parameters.name: team
parameters.tooltip: Select this checkbox and specify the team to retrieve the history of the team. if you leave the checkbox cleared (default), then your history is retrieved

parameters.title: Skip
parameters.name: skip
parameters.tooltip: The number of results that this operation should skip. By default, this is set to "0"

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Maximum number of items that this operation should return in a single search. By default, this is set to "25". You can specify any number between 1-100.

operations.title: Get Report
operations.description: Fetches the analysis report from ANY.RUN using the provided Analysis ID. This ID is automatically generated when a new analysis is submitted.

operations.title: Get Report Attachments
operations.description: Retrieve the analysis report from ANY.RUN Sandbox as attachment in JSON, HTML format using the provided Analysis ID. This ID is automatically generated when a new analysis is submitted.

operations.title: Get User Limits
operations.description: Retrieves the request limits of the authenticated user, according to the subscribed plan, from ANY.RUN.
